Binding.description:
Canonical name → dataset name, for dims and variables (``geo: market``).

Names that are not bound keep their dataset name. The binding is stored in the bundle
and reversed on every output by default.
Binding.title: Binding

BusinessPriors.description:
Beliefs in business units, per channel (keys are channel *labels* as in the data),
and/or about the baseline. At least one belief is stated: a baseline belief alone is
fine (channels without a belief keep the model's default priors).
BusinessPriors.title: BusinessPriors

Calibration.description:
The ``calibration`` block of a ``ModelSpec``: beliefs and experiment results the model
should respect. ``prior_translation_run`` records which ``translate_priors`` run produced
the priors in ``model.settings.priors`` (lineage only).

lift_tests.description: TV off in Germany for four weeks

Calibration.title: Calibration

Campaign.description: A plugin-owned fit→recommend loop (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) in one sandbox run.
Campaign.title: Campaign

ChannelBelief.description:
What the user believes about one channel: exactly one of ``roi`` or
``contribution_share``, held with ``credibility``.

* ``roi``: KPI units gained per spend unit over the fit window (``[1.5, 4]`` = "every
  euro returns between 1.5 and 4 euros of revenue");
* ``contribution_share``: the channel's share of the KPI over the fit window.

credibility.description: Probability that the true value lies inside the range (0.8 = 'I am 80% sure')
credibility.title: Credibility

ChannelBelief.title: ChannelBelief

DataBlock.description: The dataset, side tables, binding to canonical names and the split.
DataBlock.title: DataBlock

FitConfig.description: Platform fit settings. Plugin-specific limits come from the manifest's ``fit_schema``.
FitConfig.title: FitConfig

FutureCovariates.description:
Where future values of ``future_required`` covariates come from in a forecast (M3).

``supplied`` (default) needs them in the request's data or scenario
(``MISSING_FUTURE_COVARIATE`` otherwise). The other policies let the runner extend them
over the horizon, per series, inside the sandbox: ``carry_last`` repeats the last
observed value, ``seasonal_naive`` repeats the value one season earlier (the time dim's
yearly period), ``zero`` sets them to zero (e.g. "no spend planned").
FutureCovariates.title: FutureCovariates

LiftTest.description:
One experiment: ``spend_delta`` extra spend on ``channel`` (optionally in one ``geo``)
from ``start`` to ``end`` (inclusive) caused ``kpi_delta`` incremental KPI.

Give the measurement's uncertainty as a standard error ``se`` *or* a confidence interval
``ci`` at ``ci_level``. A holdout ("turn the channel off") is a negative ``spend_delta``
with (usually) a negative ``kpi_delta``.

examples.description: TV off in Germany for four weeks

spend_delta.description: Extra spend during the test (spend units)
spend_delta.title: Spend Delta

LiftTest.title: LiftTest
